description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Java 25 is the latest LTS release, providing long-term support, improved performance, new language features, and security enhancements over older JDK versions.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the JDK/Java version to 25. Update build files (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 25. Ensure all compiler settings, toolchain configurations, and CI/CD pipeline definitions reflect the new Java version. Verify that all dependencies are compatible with Java 25 and update any that are not.
tasks.summary: Upgraded Java version from 21 to 25. Updated pom.xml java.version property and Dockerfile base images (build and runtime stages) to use Java 25. Build and tests pass with JDK 25.0.4.
